def: A short, structured assessment of a candidate task before building, which sorts it into build, fix something first, use a simpler tool, or stop.
The lowest model accuracy at which automating a task costs no more per item than doing it by hand, once the cost of errors and of review is included.
A cheap early check in which twenty or thirty real, permitted inputs are run through a capable model by hand and read with the customer's expert.
A scorecard item, such as bounded error cost or permission to use the data, where a red result means stop or redesign whatever the other scores are.
The ordered options from changing the process through rules, search, classical ML and prompted models to agents, from which you pick the lowest rung that meets the bar.
A design in which a person checks model outputs before they take effect, turning costly leaked errors into cheaper corrections.
